title: Support for the Incident Controller
cross_references: Objective for Bushfire Management in Victoria
Support for the EMC and State Response Controller

nodes.text: Incident escalates in size or complexity

evidence.source_text: As the incident escalates in size or complexity, the Incident Controller will delegate some or all of the incident management functions of AIIMS.
Delegate some or all of the incident management functions of AIIMS - planning, intelligence, public information, operations, investigation, logistics and finance.

nodes.text: Build a picture of the incident

evidence.source_text: Build a picture of what has happened, what is happening and what is likely to happen.

nodes.text: Decide actions and prepare a plan

evidence.source_text: Decide what needs to be done and how it will be done. Prepare a plan that captures those decisions.
Implement the plan and monitor its progress.
Keep people and agencies informed of all these actions.

nodes.text: Maintain records of deliberations and decisions

evidence.source_text: Maintain records of their deliberations and decisions.
Manage environmental impacts and consequences of the response effort.

nodes.text: Initiate and support relief and recovery efforts

evidence.source_text: Initiate and support the relief and recovery efforts for affected communities.

nodes.text: Are two or more agencies responding?

evidence.source_text: If two or more agencies respond to an incident, the Incident Controller should form and chair an IEMT.
The Incident Controller should form and chair an IEMT.

nodes.text: Is the Incident Controller unable to attend or are there several disparate emergencies?

evidence.source_text: If the Incident Controller is unable to attend or there are several disparate emergencies within the municipality, the MERC (or representative) should form and chair the IEMT.

nodes.text: MERC forms and chairs the IEMT

evidence.source_text: The MERC (or representative) should form and chair the IEMT.

nodes.text: Consider efficacy of potential control strategies

evidence.source_text: The IEMT considers the efficacy of potential control strategies.

nodes.text: Task support agency or functional commanders

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller will task support agency or functional commanders to implement a strategy or to provide resources in support of these strategies.

nodes.text: Include strategies and actions in the Incident Action Plan

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller includes the strategies and the actions of all agencies in the Incident Action Plan.
The effective operation of an IEMT relies heavily upon communication between agencies.

nodes.text: Support the Regional Controller to develop a regional strategic plan

evidence.source_text: Support the Regional Controller to develop a regional strategic plan for the management of the emergency, outlining the regional tier actions of all agencies.
